invariants.rationale: A savepoint operation typically requires a non-null instant to identify the point being saved.
Identifying the user performing the savepoint is likely required for auditing or metadata purposes.
A HoodieEngineContext is required for performing engine-based actions, so it is likely never null when invoking this method.
The instant to savepoint should be a non-empty string after trimming; otherwise, the operation may not make sense.
The user string should be non-empty after trimming to meaningfully identify a user.
